scientific_integrity: The result concerns an explicitly specified independent-reset-clock variation, not the frontier-conditioned protocol of the original paper. Infinite-time assertions use an analytic positive-recurrent gap proof; finite tests are corroborative. Independent scientific and exhaustive historical originality reviews have not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Only asymptotic speed for biased one-dimensional nearest-neighbor motion with constant Bernoulli resetting including frontier no-ops.
No claims about finite-horizon optimality, higher cumulants, alternative reset activation rules, or general random walks.
Possible unindexed renewal-theory specializations remain a literature coverage risk.
title: Sharp drift threshold for optimal independent reset-to-record exploration
